facts.text: The hotel sits on a rocky promontory overlooking white sandy beaches and a coral reef.
facts.excerpt: Eden Rock – St Barths is located on a rocky promontory overlooking white sandy beaches, gin-clear sea and a magnificent coral reef.

facts.text: Guests can stroll from the hotel to the shops, boutiques, bars and restaurants of the village of St Jean.
facts.excerpt: the luxury hotel invites guests to stroll to the shops, boutiques, bars and restaurants situated in the pretty village of St Jean.

facts.text: The rooms, suites and villas are located either on the rock, along the beach or within beachside gardens.
facts.excerpt: located either on the rock, dotted along the beach or set within lush beachside gardens.

facts.text: The rooms, suites and villas are individually designed.
facts.excerpt: Eden Rock – St Barths has 37 individually designed rooms, suites and villas

facts.text: Each room is decorated with varied materials, fine art and books.
facts.excerpt: Each ultra luxurious room, decorated with varied materials, fine art and books, is full of personalised surprises.

facts.text: Accommodation categories include Heavenly Beach Houses.
Fine dining cuisine at night is masterminded by chef Jean-Georges Vongerichten.
facts.excerpt: fine dining cuisine by night masterminded by world famous masterchef Jean-Georges Vongerichten

facts.text: Daytime dining offers laid-back beachside menus.
facts.excerpt: with laidback beachside menus by day

facts.text: Venues include the Sand Bar restaurant, Remy Bar and Remy's Club, and the Beach Bar.
facts.excerpt: Discover the Sand Bar restaurant, Rémy Bar & Rémy's Club and the Beach Bar nearby, gleaming in the reflected blue of the Caribbean.

facts.text: Eden Spa offers treatments and massages using products created on the island, at the spa or in the guest's room.
facts.excerpt: Harmonious treatments and massages using products created on our island are to be enjoyed at Eden Spa, at the heart of Eden Rock Hotel, or in the privacy of your room.

facts.text: The spa uses Ligne St Barth treatments that combine natural ingredients with expert techniques.
facts.excerpt: The secrets of Ligne St Barth treatments lie in combining perfectly natural ingredients with expert techniques

facts.text: A table at Eden Rock is described as a priority reservation for epicureans in St Barths.
facts.excerpt: A table at Eden Rock is a priority reservation for epicureans in St Barths
